about_the_game:
In Polyopoplis you don’t drop skyscrapers—you press them into existence. Every turn begins with a set of stamps. Tap it onto the grid, hear the satisfying thunk of ink and concrete, then watch your multipliers jump. Place wisely and those shapes start feeding each other, turning single moves into cascading combos that catapult your resource bars past their targets.

Accumulated progress showers you with shiny gold coins—the lifeblood of expansion. Spend them to open booster packs of rare stamps. The deeper your collection grows, the better your tactical options and score multipliers become.

Whether you’re chasing high-score glory, perfecting your city, or simply collecting all the stamps you can, Polyopolis turns spatial puzzles into living, breathing neighbourhoods and proves that great cities are built one imprint at a time.

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7, 8, 10, 11 x64
  • Processor: Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 2.1 compatible graphics card, integrated graphics

short_description: Stamp out a thriving city by fitting shapes into a ever-changing grid to attain the most resources. Chain buildings to boost energy, people and products, gain gold coins, and unlock rare stamps in this zen-meets-strategy city builder.
